newsitem.title: USA: Creative Programming delays liquidation decision.
newsitem.headline: Creative Programming delays liquidation decision.

text.p: Creative Programming and Technology Ventures Inc said Wednesday it will wait another 30 days before making a decision or holding a vote on a proposal to liquidate the company.

The company adjourned its annual meeting on April 17 without considering the issue. It had originally planned to reconvene today but said it now plans to hold a meeting to consider the matter on June 19. It said it continues in the meantime to evaluate new business opportunities.
